description: Search Australia Wide First Aid's documentation by keyword: the developer portal, agent guide, auth.md, llms.txt files, pricing, corporate, about, privacy and terms pages, and the first aid library's article and glossary titles and summaries. Returns up to five sections, best first, each with its heading, document name, page URL and text; empty when nothing matches. Use get_doc for a whole document.

query.description: What to look for, in a few words (at most 200 characters), such as api key, refund or CPR.

name: search_docs

results.description: The best-matching sections, best first (at most five). Empty when nothing matches.

heading.description: The section's heading path, or the library item's title.

text.description: The section's text, or the library item's summary (at most 2,000 characters).

url.description: The page it is on, with the section's anchor where the page has one.

title: Search the docs
